answer: The authors reported **“>90% accuracy”** for precisely localizing intermediate states on synthetic domains, stating that they could “**precisely localize the intermediate states up to feature permutation with >90% accuracy**.” This appears on **DBLP_journals_corr_abs-2302-01976.pdf, page 1** (also in **conf_iclr_gupta2025sparling.pdf, page 1**).
